description: Data Scientists at QuantCo will learn what it takes to create impact from data.
descriptionPlain: Data Scientists at QuantCo will learn what it takes to create impact from data.

lists.text: We are looking for team players who have excellent quantitative abilities and:
lists.content:
• A degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, physics, or similar fields at a leading university

lists.text: Bonus if skilled in any of the following tools and/or languages:
